title: 第二十五章 重逢第二十六章 重归木叶
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
鸣人和佐助，小樱等人不由得瞪大了眼睛！他们根本看不见波风冥帝方才的动作！
这岂不是说波风冥帝想杀他们，易如反掌？
“卡多，现在你给我钱吗？”波风冥帝微微一笑，道“其实我要的不多。”
“真的？”卡多望着波风冥帝。
“当然。”波风冥帝点了点头“只不过是全部家当而已！”闻言，卡多脸皮抽搐了起来。
“不给的话，他们便是你的榜样！”波风冥帝嘴角依旧带着阳光般的微笑，可如今卡多看见这微笑，身子不由颤抖了起来，便是拿出了存折！冥帝也不跟卡多，拿过了存折，看了一眼，微微一笑。
卡多还真的是很有钱啊！
“好！我放你一马。”波风冥帝拿了存折之后，笑道“但是.....”冥帝看向了已经到来的波之国村民道“那些人放不放你，这就不是我能决定的了的。”
“什么？”卡多惊慌！接着波风冥帝一脚便是将卡多当球踢，直接踢向了那些村名。当然，可多的下场，那是可想而知了！
“好强！”鸣人看着波风冥帝的背影，羡慕的喃喃自语。波风冥帝在这里，完全将卡卡多，再不斩的光芒给掩盖了。佐助本以为觉醒了写轮眼，一切都好，可是他没想道“怎么会？写轮眼居然看不见他的动作？”
卡卡西也是无奈的叹了口气，他也就是能看见波风冥帝的残影而已！没想到几年过去，波风冥帝的实力已经将自己完完全全的给甩了。
“冥帝，你真的很强！”卡卡多走了出来，看了看鸣人，又是对着冥帝道“你今天是来看你这个弟弟的吧？”
“恩？”听到卡卡西这句话，鸣人不由得看向了波风冥帝“你是我老哥吗？”
用得着加个“老”字吗？波风冥帝叹了口气，便是点了点头“傻弟弟！你真的很傻！”
“老哥。”鸣人一直孤零零的，没想到今天终于看见了自己的哥哥，不由一把鼻涕一把泪的哭了起来，最后扑到了冥帝的身上。
用得着这么夸张吗？冥帝微微笑了笑“鸣人，男子汉可是不能掉眼泪的哦！”鸣人一听，便是将眼泪擦掉。
而波风冥帝也是拿下了那银质面具，露出了俊俏的一张脸！“哇好帅！比佐助还帅！”小樱看着，不由又是开始发花痴了。
“他就是鸣人的哥哥，连鼬都敬佩的人物吗？”佐助看着波风冥帝，不由想起来了宇智波鼬！
而小樱更是惊讶了，鸣人这个吊车尾有个哥哥，还是天才这么厉害？再看看他们两个人的长相，简直天差地别了。
“卡卡西大哥，你们的任务也该结束了吧？”波风冥帝朝着卡卡西微微笑道。

“恩！”卡卡西点了点头“事情差不多已经解决了。我想是时候回村了。”
这时候鸣人打量了几眼波风冥帝，随后叫道“老哥，我们的爸爸妈妈是谁？是不是很厉害的忍者？”
鸣人怎么这么问？
难怪说.......鸣人的遭遇还是和原著之中一摸一样吗？波风冥帝皱起了眉头，原本他以为有他的存在，长老团怎么也该收敛点，没想到还是这么放肆！
波风冥帝紧握拳头，难道团藏真的那么嚣张，自以为是，不把他波风冥帝放在眼里，以为他波风冥帝会死在外面？
波风冥帝充满杀意的气势不由一瞬间如大海决堤一般，源源不断的爆发出来！波风冥帝眼神带上了怒气。在这一股气势之下，鸣人小樱佐助，包括在场村民们都是不由震慑的瘫坐在了地上。
而卡卡西，再不斩苦苦支撑，但额头也已经冒出了冷汗。此时冥帝的眼眸盯上了卡卡西，卡卡西不由心中一慌！“卡卡西大哥，鸣人真的连自己的身世都不知道吗？”
卡卡西在冥帝气势之下，不由低下了头“鸣人的身世属于木叶s级机密！”
“是吗？”冥帝深沉的道！随即将冰冷的气势完全收了起来。他知道，他必须找张老头团藏几个人算算账！
让他们知道，以后别太放肆！
“好强，光光是气势，居然这么强？”佐助瘫坐地上，一脸惊恐的望着波风冥帝的身影，他被誉为天才，可是他没想到，比他只不过大了几岁的波风冥帝，居然比他强了这么多。
鸣人更是一脸不解！为什么老哥会对这个感到了愤怒。看着鸣人一脸迷惑，冥帝深呼吸了一口气，朝着鸣人，缓缓的道“鸣人，你知道吗？我们的父亲他可是....”
“冥帝。”卡卡西打断道。波风冥帝冷眸望着卡卡西，呵呵笑道“卡卡西大哥，难道说，鸣人连自己的身世都不能知道吗？”
卡卡西叹了口气，再次的低下了头去。
“鸣人，你听着，我的名字是波风冥帝。”波风冥帝缓缓的道“而你也不该叫漩涡鸣人，而是波风鸣人！傻弟弟，你知道波风这两个字，在木叶代表着什么吗？”
“什么？”鸣人还是一如既往的傻，摇了摇头。而小樱，佐助脸色诧异.....难道是？
再不斩更没想到居然会有这样的故事了！方才鸣人爆发出来的查克拉，再不斩其实也认了出来，这便是九尾查克拉！
可是他完全没想到的是，九尾人柱力居然会是银色恶魔波风冥帝的弟弟？
“鸣人！我们父亲，便是木叶第四代火影，有着金色闪光之称的天才，波风水门！”
“什么？”鸣人傻眼“老爸是，第四代火影？”鸣人完全震惊了。

“鸣人的老爸？真的是四代火影？”小樱不敢相信，身为木叶的儿子，可是小时候却备受欺负？佐助也是惊讶的看着鸣人，没想到鸣人身份这么显贵？
佐助，小樱虽然心中有了猜测，可波风冥帝亲口说出来，还是震撼人心。
“我们的母亲，是千手一族的远亲，漩涡一族的人，叫漩涡玖辛奈。”波风冥帝继续缓缓的道“当年，九尾进攻木叶，正好赶上你出生的时候！那时候九尾的力量，木叶无人可挡！水门老爸牺牲了自己，将九尾作为礼物，封印在了你的体内。”

content_en:
Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura and others couldn't help but widen their eyes! They couldn't see what Emperor Namikaze had done just now!
Doesn't this mean that Namikaze Hades wants to kill them easily?
"Kado, will you give me money now?" Namikaze Underworld smiled slightly and said, "Actually, I don't want much."
"Really?" Kado looked at Namikaze Hades.
"Of course." Emperor Namikaze nodded. "It's just all the belongings!" Upon hearing this, Kado's face twitched.
"If you don't give it, they will be your role models!" Namikaze Hades still had a sunny smile on his lips, but now that Kado saw this smile, his body couldn't help but tremble, and he took out his bankbook! Emperor Hades did not follow Kaduo. He took the bankbook, glanced at it, and smiled.
Kado is really rich!
"Okay! I'll let you go." After Emperor Namikaze took the bankbook, he smiled and said, "But..." Emperor Hades looked at the villagers from the Country of Waves who had arrived and said, "Whether those people let you go or not is not something I can decide."
"What?" Kaduo panicked! Then Namikaze Hades used Kado as a ball and kicked it directly towards the village names. Of course, one can imagine what will happen to Keduo!
"So strong!" Naruto murmured enviously as he looked at Namikaze Hades' back. Namikaze Hades is here, completely covering up the light of Kakado and Zabuza. Sasuke thought that everything would be fine after awakening the Sharingan, but he never thought, "How could it be? The Sharingan can't actually see his movements?"
Kakashi also sighed helplessly, he could only see the afterimage of Namikaze Hades! Unexpectedly, a few years later, Namikaze Underworld's strength had completely defeated him.
"Emperor Hades, you are really strong!" Kakado came out, looked at Naruto, and then said to Emperor Hades, "Are you here to see your younger brother today?"
"Well?" After hearing Kakashi's words, Naruto couldn't help but look at Namikaze Hades, "Are you my brother?"
Is it necessary to add the word "老"? Namikaze Hades sighed and nodded, "Silly brother! You are really stupid!"
"Brother." Naruto has always been alone, but he didn't expect to finally see his brother today. He couldn't help crying with snot and tears, and finally threw himself on Hades.
Is it necessary to be so exaggerated? Emperor Hades smiled slightly, "Naruto, a man can't shed tears!" Upon hearing this, Naruto wiped away his tears.
And Emperor Namikaze also took off the silver mask, revealing a handsome face! "Wow, he's so handsome! Even more handsome than Sasuke!" Sakura looked at him and couldn't help but start to feel crazy again.
"Is he Naruto's brother, a figure that even Itachi admires?" Sasuke looked at Namikaze Hades and couldn't help but think of Uchiha Itachi!
And Sakura was even more surprised. Naruto, who is a genius, has an older brother, or is he such a genius? Looking at the looks of the two of them, they are completely different.
"Brother Kakashi, your mission should be over, right?" Namikaze Hades smiled at Kakashi.
"Yes!" Kakashi nodded. "The matter is almost settled. I think it's time to return to the village."
At this time, Naruto looked at Namikaze Hades for a few times, and then called out, "Brother, who are our parents? Are they very powerful ninjas?"
Why did Naruto ask that?
No wonder... Is Naruto's experience still exactly the same as in the original work? Emperor Namikaze frowned. He originally thought that with his presence, the group of elders should restrain themselves, but he didn't expect that they would still be so presumptuous!
Namikaze Hades clenched his fists. Is Danzo really so arrogant and self-righteous that he didn't take him into consideration and thought that Namikaze Hades would die outside?
The murderous aura of Namikaze Hades couldn't help but burst out like a sea bursting its banks in an instant! Emperor Namikaze's eyes were filled with anger. Under this momentum, Naruto, Sakura, Sasuke, and the villagers present couldn't help but slumped to the ground in shock.
As for Kakashi, Zabuza struggled to hold on, but cold sweat broke out on his forehead. At this time, Emperor Hades' eyes were fixed on Kakashi, and Kakashi couldn't help but panic! "Brother Kakashi, does Naruto really not even know his own life experience?"
Kakashi couldn't help but lower his head under the aura of Hades, "Naruto's life experience is an S-level secret of Konoha!"
"Really?" Emperor Hades said deeply! Then he completely put away his icy aura. He knew that he had to settle the score with Old Man Zhang and several people from Tuanzang!
Let them know not to be too presumptuous in the future!
"It's so strong. Just the aura, how strong is it?" Sasuke collapsed on the ground, looking at the figure of Namikaze Hades with a horrified expression. He was hailed as a genius, but he didn't expect that Namikaze Hades, who was only a few years older than him, was so much stronger than him.
Naruto was even more puzzled! Why is my brother so angry about this? Seeing Naruto's confused face, Hades took a deep breath and said slowly to Naruto, "Naruto, do you know? Our father is..."
"Underworld Emperor." Kakashi interrupted. Namikaze Hade looked at Kakashi coldly, and said with a smile, "Brother Kakashi, can it be said that Naruto can't even know his own life experience?"
Kakashi sighed and lowered his head again.
"Naruto, listen, my name is Namikaze Hades." Namikaze Hades said slowly, "And you shouldn't be called Uzumaki Naruto, but Namikaze Naruto! Silly brother, do you know what the word Namikaze means in Konoha?"
"What?" Naruto was still as stupid as ever and shook his head. As for Sakura and Sasuke, they looked surprised... Could it be?
Zabuza never expected that there would be such a story! Zabuza actually recognized the chakra that Naruto had just burst out. This was the Nine-Tails Chakra!
But what he didn't expect at all was that the Nine-Tailed Jinchuuriki would actually be the younger brother of the silver demon Namikaze Hade?
"Naruto! Our father is the fourth Hokage of Konoha, a genius known as the Golden Flash, Namikaze Minato!"
"What?" Naruto was dumbfounded. "Dad is the Fourth Hokage?" Naruto was completely shocked.
"Naruto's dad? Is he really the Fourth Hokage?" Sakura couldn't believe it. As the son of Konoha, he was bullied when he was a child? Sasuke also looked at Naruto in surprise. He didn't expect Naruto to be so distinguished?
Sasuke and Sakura had some guesses in their minds, but Namikaze Hades said it himself, which was still shocking.
"Our mother is a distant relative of the Senju Clan and a member of the Uzumaki Clan, named Uzumaki Kushina." Namikaze Emperor continued slowly, "Back then, the Nine-Tails attacked Konoha, just in time for you to be born! At that time, the power of the Nine-Tails was unstoppable in Konoha! Minato's father sacrificed himself and sealed the Nine-Tails in your body as a gift."
